read_endpoint.name: thread-history-v3
read_endpoint.purpose: Task screen initial render and refresh recovery

implementation_steps.name: initial-load-v3
implementation_steps.detail: When the task screen opens or refreshes, call GET /v3/client/workspaces/{workspace_id}/ai-agent/tasks/{task_id}/threads and use it as the canonical read model.

implementation_steps.name: group-by-conversation-id
implementation_steps.detail: Render one Agent comment card per conversation_id. thread_id is the concrete run/thread record inside that card, not the card grouping key.

implementation_steps.name: optimistic-v2-mutation
implementation_steps.detail: For assign, message, stop, and delete, use the existing v2 mutation endpoint and apply an optimistic UI update immediately from the mutation response.

implementation_steps.name: refetch-v3-after-mutation
implementation_steps.detail: After each v2 mutation settles, refetch v3 thread history to recover persisted user messages, agent replies, progress rows, and historical snapshots.

response_shapes.name: AIAgentTaskThreadHistoryCollectionResponse
response_shapes.purpose: Top-level response for one task screen. The frontend should treat threads as timeline records and resolve display metadata through agent_snapshots.

response_shapes.name: AIAgentTaskThreadHistoryRecord
response_shapes.purpose: One persisted AI thread/run record in the task timeline. Multiple records may share conversation_id when they belong to the same visible Agent comment card.

response_shapes.name: AIAgentTaskThreadHistoryMessage
response_shapes.purpose: One stable timeline row inside a thread history record. message_id is the React row key; body can contain sanitized HTML from a user reply.

action_endpoints.name: assign-agent-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Assign one AI Agent to the task

action_endpoints.name: thread-message-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Send a user follow-up message to one AI thread

action_endpoints.name: stop-agent-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Stop one assigned AI Agent in a task

action_endpoints.name: delete-agent-assignment-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Remove one assigned AI Agent from a task while preserving history

identity_rules.name: task_id
identity_rules.use: Group all AI thread history for one task screen

identity_rules.name: conversation_id
identity_rules.use: Render one Agent conversation card; same value means reply chain, different value means separate card even for same agent_id

identity_rules.name: thread_id
identity_rules.use: Route v2 user messages and render sub-run blocks inside a conversation card

identity_rules.name: parent_thread_id
identity_rules.meaning: Source thread for a follow-up run
identity_rules.use: Nest a follow-up run under the original Agent comment when present

identity_rules.name: assignment_id
identity_rules.use: Manage execution status and stop/delete targeting

identity_rules.name: run_id
identity_rules.use: Deduplicate live progress together with assignment_id and seq

identity_rules.name: message_id
identity_rules.use: Render messages without collapsing repeated user bodies or repeated progress text

grouping_rules: Agent comment card key is conversation_id, not thread_id.
A new participant-dropdown reassignment creates a new conversation_id even when agent_id is the same.
A user reply submitted to an existing thread keeps the existing conversation_id.
parent_thread_id is present only when a follow-up run is derived from an existing thread.
provider, runtime_kind, label, and agent name must never be used for dedupe.
agent_snapshot_rules: Each thread may carry agent_snapshot_id instead of an embedded agent snapshot.
The screen resolves agent_snapshots[thread.agent_snapshot_id] for display.
Historical cards must keep the captured snapshot even if the current agent settings change.

message_roles.meaning: User follow-up instruction inside the AI thread
Runtime progress log, ordered by seq inside assignment_id and run_id
Agent status or final result message

interaction_scenarios.name: intent-clarification-before-deliverable
interaction_scenarios.detail: When the task title/document is marketing, analysis, planning, or otherwise intent-oriented rather than an explicit instruction, the agent's first visible answer should ask a concise clarification question in the existing thread before producing deliverables.

interaction_scenarios.name: non-command-component-document-asks-first
interaction_scenarios.detail: When a project, milestone, task, or subtask has document content but no explicit action signal, classify it as intent-oriented and ask what to do first before the daemon receives runnable work.

interaction_scenarios.name: intent-clarification-waits-for-user
interaction_scenarios.detail: When the runtime reports assignment_result_status=needs_input, v3 history keeps the agent question in the same conversation with work_status=waiting_for_user; a user reply to that thread creates a follow-up run under the same conversation_id without changing endpoint shape.

interaction_scenarios.name: concrete-followup-authoritative
interaction_scenarios.detail: When the user replies in that thread with a concrete instruction, render the user message in the same conversation_id and let the follow-up run treat that latest message as the current directive while re-reading the latest task document.

interaction_scenarios.name: draft-then-research-limit-in-same-conversation
interaction_scenarios.detail: A marketing-copy task can first ask what to do, then complete a copywriting draft from the user's concrete follow-up, then accept another follow-up for research in the same conversation_id. If provider quota is exhausted during that research run, only the latest run fails with the normalized cloud-credit message; the prior draft result remains visible.

interaction_scenarios.name: provider-limit-result
interaction_scenarios.detail: When provider token, quota, or cloud-credit exhaustion stops the run, keep the same conversation and render the normalized result message: 보유하신 크레딧이 부족합니다. 더 깊은 리서치를 진행하려면 추가 Cloud AI 자원이 필요합니다.

interaction_scenarios.name: handoff-after-provider-limit
interaction_scenarios.detail: When the user assigns another agent after a provider-limit result, the new agent must create a separate conversation_id while the limited research conversation and prior draft remain visible in v3 history.

ordering_rules.name: conversation-card-ordering
ordering_rules.detail: First group by conversation_id. Inside a group, render root threads before records whose parent_thread_id points at that root.

ordering_rules.name: message-row-ordering
ordering_rules.detail: Within one thread record, render messages by observed_at, then role order user -> progress -> agent, then seq, then message_id. Use message_id as the stable row key, not body text.

ordering_rules.name: progress-dedupe-ordering
ordering_rules.detail: For SSE progress, use assignment_id + run_id + seq when assignment_id exists, and fall back to thread_id + run_id + seq for compatibility.

ordering_rules.name: late-terminal-guard
ordering_rules.detail: If an assignment is already completed, failed, stopped, cancelled, or timeout, ignore late runtime progress that tries to revive it as running.

mutation_rules.name: assign-agent
mutation_rules.detail: POST the v2 agent-assignments endpoint with agent_id. Same provider or same agent_id can still produce a distinct conversation when the user performs a new participant-dropdown assignment.

mutation_rules.name: send-thread-message
mutation_rules.detail: POST the task-scoped v2 thread message endpoint with thread_id. The follow-up should remain in the same conversation_id and set parent_thread_id when it creates a follow-up run.

mutation_rules.name: stop-agent
mutation_rules.detail: POST the task-scoped v2 stop endpoint, preferably including assignment_id. The UI should close the work immediately from control-plane truth; daemon acknowledgement is eventual.

mutation_rules.name: delete-agent
mutation_rules.detail: DELETE the task-scoped v2 assignment endpoint. Historical v3 thread history must stay visible even when the current agent profile is removed.

sse_handling_rules: Open one task-level SSE stream from the v2 thread-stream-subscription response.
Filter payloads by task_id, agent_id, thread_id, and run_id.
Use assignment_id + run_id + seq as the progress dedupe key when assignment_id is present.
SSE is a live update input; v3 thread history remains the refresh recovery truth.
Do not revive a terminal assignment when a late runtime progress event arrives.

loop.observation: The AI Agent client API doc repeated contract, generated-client, smoke, deployment, and runtime rules as prose while the machine-readable mirrors already existed.
loop.hypothesis: A compact SSOT gate can prove the OpenAPI/generated client/smoke matrix mirror and keep required runtime/deployment strings visible without using prose as truth.
loop.execute: Generate this reader doc from the manifest and run the aiagentclientapi verifier in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier checks contract file presence, OpenAPI operation counts, v1/v2 split, generated path coverage, smoke matrix parity, source anchors, generated doc freshness, and CLI evidence output.
loop.retrospective: This slice proves the public control-plane mirror and generated-client evidence; canonical domain changes still start in riido-contracts.
